Convex metric space.question: This is stronger than the original _____ convexity, as it is not satisfied with just one point between x and y, but requires a continuum of points - one for every real number in [0, d(x,y)]
Convex metric space.fact: A metric space (X,d) is called Strongly Menger convex if for any two distinct points x and y in X, and for every number r between 0 and d(x,y), there exists a third point z in X lying between x and y, such that d(x,z)=r.
